title: devbin's code and the dev, opt and brew contract agree, in the 25 places where they differ now
objective: devbin's code and docs/dev-opt-brew.md, the dev, opt and brew contract, agree. Each place where they differ now, listed below, is fixed in the code or amended in the contract. Each amendment goes to molt-vc, utilz-vc, intent-vc and gtools-vc, and is agreed when all four answer (devbin-vc's watchout 36). Size M.
body:
docs/dev-opt-brew.md, the dev, opt and brew contract, and devbin's code differ in the places below. For each one, fix the code to meet the contract, or amend the contract to say what the code does. Each contract amendment goes to molt-vc, utilz-vc, intent-vc and gtools-vc, and is agreed when all four answer (devbin-vc's watchout 36). dc's close-out of 2026-11-27 found these by one read of the code and did not change the contract. Read each one in the code again before acting on it.

Where the contract says what the code does not (line, then the code):

- 18: the runtime set is what git names. devbin's own set is `bin/devbin` and every file under `lib/`, tracked or not (lib/install, vendored_paths); only its publish gate asks git.
- 19: the install place comes from a config key or a variable. Only `--prefix` and `install.prefix` are read; no variable is.
- 20: the tool file's lines are `key: value`, and a directory entry is itself. The file opens with three `#` lines, and a directory entry is `:(literal)<dir>` with one `:(exclude,glob)` line for each exclude (lib/tool).
- 26: publish from opt or brew is refused by name. In devbin's opt or brew tree, `install` vendors into the current directory; only `--prefix` and `--managed-by` are refused (lib/cmd/install).
- 27: only the runtime set counts for a clean publish. True for a tool; devbin's own publish refuses anything `git status --porcelain` lists in its checkout (lib/install, tree_dirty_paths).
- 28: a prefix that holds anything else is refused. True for a tool; devbin's own publish refuses only a dev tree, a keg and an install it did not write.
- 29: `install` and `use` writes into a keg are refused. `use` writes only links; the refusals are `install --force --prefix <keg>` and `install --into <keg>`, each naming `brew upgrade <tool>`.
- 35: the manifest path is named in each tool's docs. It is `install.manifest`, default `.<tool>-install` (lib/config, cfg_tool_manifest).
- 36 and 41: the header carries `line`, and `bin/devbin install` writes it. devbin's manifest has no `line`; devbin makes its line from `version` and `source_commit`. A tool's publish and the formula's assets install write `line`.
- 43: the body is in `LC_ALL=C sort` order. devbin's body puts `bin/devbin` first, then `bin/.devbin/lib/` in C order.
- 44: doctor in opt and brew checks the body. devbin's opt and brew trees refuse `doctor` (exit 5); doctor in a tool's checkout checks each tree the link set serves.
- 45 against 72 to 74: the code holds no copy of the manifest's name, but T4's Rust reader holds it in `MANIFEST`. (Unsure: the contract contradicts itself here.)
- 46: brew trees are found through `$(brew --prefix)`. The root is compared with `$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/opt/<tool>/libexec` from the environment; no `brew` runs.
- 59: `+dirty` never in opt or brew. devbin's opt or brew line keeps a `+dirty` that `source_commit` records.
- 65: the build's inputs are `build.inputs`. `build.artefacts.<name>.inputs` count too (lib/config, cfg_build_input_paths).
- 105: `use brew` removes the whole link set, and its refusal names each link and its tree. A foreign link or a file where a link belongs stops it and removes nothing. A tool's refusal names only the first link and no tree; three more causes refuse it (Homebrew's bin not on PATH, its copy will not run, the copy linked only through the link). use.bats pins this sentence.
- 108: doctor's rows for a tool leave out the facts row (`.devbin-tool` against the `install:` block).
- 109: an option names the link directory for tests. No such option exists; the core reads `$HOME/.local/bin`.
- 110: `use` restarts a long-lived process as its last step. `tool_use` restarts nothing, and no `install:` key names a restart.
- 125: opt and brew refuse by name, naming the dev tree. devbin's opt and brew trees refuse every verb but `install`, `shell-init`, `use`, the version forms and help (exit 5), and name the install, not a dev tree.
- 130: the tap is `matthewsinclair/homebrew-<tool>`. It is `--tap`, else `formula.tap`, else `homebrew-<tool>` under the release repository's owner; publish asks a person first and leaves a tap that has the render.
- 131: the stage is copied into libexec, never moved. A stage that is only a `bin` directory is moved into `libexec/bin`.
- 134: the caveats name `bin/devbin use` in the checkout. devbin's own template names `devbin use` and no checkout.
- 153 to 156: in devbin's checkout, doctor names the install and `upgrade` reads it. There `upgrade` refuses and names `install --force`, and doctor prints no `install:` row.

Lines that record history, for the same amendment: 7 ("gives up its own copy of each"), 42 ("so a manifest written before it stays valid"), 46 ("written before this contract", "a keg from before the contract"), 61 (the old line shape "during the change"), 109 (Utilz's retired `relink`), 133 ("Molt 1.4.8's install failed for want of it"), 145 (the retired machine pointer file).

Tests pin some of the contract's words. Change them in the same commit as the text: documentation.bats (the T2 and T5 headings and no `<tool> install|use|version`; the Intent sentence; T4's paragraph ending " Doctor prints the same line, unchanged."; the Rust block built under clippy) and use.bats (the switch rests at brew; the line 105 refusal sentence; the two rehash sentences on line 112).
